title: Protocol   Griess Test
author: Tamiris Silva

steps_raw.instruction: Prepare standard sodium nitrite solution for standard curve:
Dissolve 0,06899g NaNO2 (10mM Sodium Nitrite / 10,000µM) in 100 mL distilled water and place in dark flask at room temperature
Prepare the standard curve by the serial dilution form;
Use 7 microtubes identified with the different concentrations prepared from the initial nitrite concentration.:
Adicione no primeiro microtubo 8 µL de nitrite (10mM/10.000µM) + 492 µL PBS
Transfer 250 µL from the initial tube to the second to last tube, which must contain 250 µL for serial dilution, since the final volume will be 250 (50 µL for each quadruplicate well);
Use the last well to place the blank (supplemented culture medium only);
add 50µL of Griess reagent to all wells containing samples and standard curve,
